title: Personal Credit Cards: minimum interest charge and courtesy reversal allowances by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: minimum interest charge and courtesy allowances

This quick reference covers the Personal Credit Cards line. It lists, for every card tier, the smallest interest charge billed in a cycle in which any interest is due, how many courtesy reversals of residual (trailing) interest a customer is allowed in a rolling 365 days, how many courtesy late fee reversals a customer is allowed in a rolling 365 days, and how many consecutive on-time payments must immediately precede the late one for a courtesy late fee reversal.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Minimum interest charge | Courtesy reversals of residual interest per rolling 365 days | Courtesy late fee reversals per rolling 365 days | Consecutive on-time payments required before the late one |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 1.00 USD | 1 | 1 | 6 |
| College Rewards Visa | 0.50 USD | 1 | 1 | 3 |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 1.00 USD | 1 | 1 | 6 |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 1.00 USD | 1 | 1 | 6 |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 1.00 USD | 1 | 2 | 3 |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 0.00 USD | 2 | 3 | 0 |

## What the columns mean

- **Minimum interest charge**: the smallest interest charge billed in a cycle in which any interest is due.
- **Residual interest courtesy allowance**: the number of courtesy reversals of residual (trailing) interest allowed per customer in a rolling 365 days.
- **Late fee courtesy allowance**: the number of courtesy late fee reversals allowed per customer in a rolling 365 days.
- **Required on-time run**: the number of consecutive on-time payments, immediately before the late one, that a courtesy late fee reversal requires.

## Points of judgement

- The allowances are counted per customer, not per card.
- On Visa Infinite Private Client the required on-time run is 0, so a run of at least that many payments is present in any payment history.
- Travel Rewards Visa Signature and College Rewards Visa require the shorter run of 3 on-time payments; Secured Visa, Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa require 6.
